collection.title: VW Jetta 2006 to 2011 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Jetta 2006 to 2011 model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
